title: Change a scene: add the second emitter
summary: Open the finished merge scene, add the emitter of line B that it lacks and bind its signal in the plant map, without touching the program that already arbitrates the two lines.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Add a part to an existing scene and place it where the rest of the scene expects it.
Bind the new part's signal in the plant map to the program variable that already drives it, leaving the program unchanged.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: Open scene.json in the Scene editor: the merge scene has no emitter for line B. Add an emitter named EmitterB at the start of feeder B, with a limit of three boxes, and in plant-map.json bind EmitterB.emit to MergeLines.EmitB. The program in src/MergeLines.st already drives EmitB; leave it as it is.
stages.checkpoint: The scene has EmitterB, the plant map binds EmitterB.emit, and the program is the one you were given.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, think about what changes when line B gets its emitter: three boxes now arrive on each feeder, and the arbitration has to let them through one at a time, as before.
stages.checkpoint: Both blades hold the lines at first; then one blade opens at a time, line A first; all six boxes leave and Done turns on.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save the scene and the plant map, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter scene has no emitter for line B, so no box ever comes from feeder B; add EmitterB at the start of feeder B with a limit of three boxes, and bind EmitterB.emit to MergeLines.EmitB in the plant map.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named change-scene and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch feeder B fill with boxes and wait at its blade; if the part or its binding is missing, read the message of the Check: it names what it cannot find.
stages.checkpoint: All six boxes are delivered in turn, no box collides or drops, and Done is on at the end.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The program did not change, so the scene alone decided the result; a part that is added but not bound is as absent as a part that was never added.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: Copy the settings of EmitterA: an emitter with a limit of three boxes; EmitterB sits on the line of feeder B, at position 0, 0.65, 1.95 and rotated 90 degrees.
In the plant map the signal is EmitterB.emit, a command, and its point is MergeLines.EmitB; check the name letter by letter, because the Check reads it exactly.

faultCases: The starter scene has no emitter for line B, so no box ever comes from feeder B; add EmitterB at the start of feeder B with a limit of three boxes, and bind EmitterB.emit to MergeLines.EmitB in the plant map.
